description: Which checklist items are draft Tasks, as every RelayMark editor decides it. The armed set is the client's local state, never stored in the document: callers pass it in and get the next one back. Documents are ProseMirror JSON with block identity. `task_drafts` lists unlinked task items, with operation_id = relaymarkId `b` + 32 lowercase hex as a lowercase UUID; any other id gives no draft. `task_draft_arm` takes [before, after] and an event: input_rule, command and split arm new items (command only empty ones, split only when `from` was armed), arm and disarm take ids, external (remote, paste, history) only prunes. Ids in arm and disarm are block ids, not operation ids. `after` is the document once block identity is assigned: task items with the same id are refused. For external, arm and disarm `before` may be null and is never read. A caller skips task_draft_arm for an external event while nothing is armed, and may prune by itself (armed ids that are still unlinked, well-formed task items in `after`) without calling the job, so a peer's edit never costs whole-document work. `task_draft_boundary` lists the armed drafts with a title that Return, a caret move or a checkbox tap finishes. `return` is unmodified Return (Shift-Return is a hard break, not a boundary); `move` is any caret move between `before` and `after`, a pointer press elsewhere included; `composing` (an input method composing) finishes nothing for return and move, while a checkbox tap still finishes. Positions are ProseMirror positions, and a caret is in an item when pos < caret <= pos + 1 + first paragraph size. Each task_draft_arm case also names the editor `action` that produces it (a case with `expected_error` instead of `expected` is a refusal and has none) from `before` (or from `after` when `before` is null) at ProseMirror positions: typed text at a caret, an editor command over a selection, a key at a caret, a whole-document replace standing for any external change, or the event's own arm or disarm; editors replay it and must reach `after` (block identity aside) with the expected armed items.
